283 likes, 622 comments - simrun.chopra on October 6, 2026: "If you're trying to lose weight, what you do before noon may matter more than you think.

Start your morning with these 5 habits:

1. Get 30 to 40 g protein at breakfast
  Think eggs, Greek yoghurt, paneer, tofu, or a protein-rich chilla.

2. Eat around 30% of your daily calories before lunch
  Stop saving most of your calories for dinner. Front-load more of your food.

3. Don't fear morning carbs
  Fruit, oats, poha, dosa, roti or other whole-food carbs are great for carb loading mornings instead of high carbs at lunch and dinner. 

4. Drink 1 to 1.5 L water before noon
  A simple way to stay hydrated and support appetite control. Adjust for your body, climate and activity.

5. Take vitamin D and omega-3 with breakfast
  If you use them, taking them with a meal containing some fat can improve absorption. They're not fat burners, but they can support overall health.

None of these is a magic fat-loss hack.

Together, they create a morning that makes staying in a calorie deficit much easier.

Want 100 high-protein breakfast ideas that are vegetarian or vegetarian + eggs?

Comment BREAKFAST and I'll send them to you.".

3,010 likes, 26K comments - simrun.chopra on October 4, 2026: "Drop a comment for a detailed version as well + hair growth super seed powder recipe + a whole list of symptoms to help you identify what might be causing your hair issues. Youre going to be surprised at home much ive included in the full version

You can also tell me if there is anything you want me to deep dive into 

Remember this is via just food and health so it will take time
Think of it like watering and feeding a tree. Adding fertiliser and taking care of it. 
If you keep watering it grows. If you stop over time it starts shrivelling up 
So this is a life long thing if you want great hear 

1. Control your hormonal issues - for me it was pcos - while you are doing this start with the others 
2. Check all your vitamin levels and supplement the ones that are low. In the detailed version ive listed all 
3. Ensure your vitamin D and iron profile are always In range 

Now the food bit 
1. Atleast 1 gm of protein per kg of body weight everyday forever. If you misss a day or 2 it’s fine. You should hit this goal atleast 90% of the year 
2. Take an omega 3 daily with enough EPA and DHA. Especially if you are someone who doesnt eat omega 3 rich fish atleast 3 to 4 times a week. 
3. Ensure you have atleast 1 type of probiotic food daily be it curd, kimchi, kombucha, kanji or a supplement 
4. Have an alma shot or add vitamin C to each meal for iron absorption. Its as simple as adding lime to a salad especially if youre a vegetarian 
5. Whole grains - chickpeas, rajma, channa etc. rotate these through the week and atleast once a day. These help with trace minerals like zinc, sellum and biotin 
6. Eat an egg daily if you are non veg and dark leafy greens atleast 3 times a week for more biotin 
7. You need a ton of trace minerals for which you can use my hair growth super seed powder recipe as well 

Hair care 
1. No tight hairstyles that pull the hair 
2. I dont brush my hair a lot, there is no point tugging at it all the time. I never ever use a comb and it causes a lot of tugging. I only use a detangle brush 
3. Add a little serum to the hair ends daily to prevent split ends. I use a rebounding agent

Continued in the comments..".

112 likes, 53 comments - simrun.chopra on September 29, 2026: "Your Hb is “normal” but you’re exhausted, losing hair or craving ice? Your iron stores could still be low.

Look out for:

1. Feeling tired all the time
2. Craving non-food items like ice or raw rice
3. Nails that break easily
4. Increased hair fall
5. Breathlessness or unusual weakness
6. Dizziness or difficulty concentrating

Here’s what most people miss:

Iron deficiency does not always mean low haemoglobin.

Hb tells you about your red blood cells.
Ferritin gives us an indication of your stored iron.

That’s why, when assessing iron status, don’t look at Hb alone.

An iron profile may include:

• Ferritin
• Serum iron
• TIBC / Transferrin
• Transferrin saturation

Ferritin is an important marker, but it can also rise with inflammation, so it should be interpreted alongside the other results and your clinical picture.

Comment FERRITIN and I’ll do a series on how to improve your ferritin levels.".

244 likes, 1,453 comments - simrun.chopra on September 28, 2026: "Comment “peri" and I’ll send you a perimenopause guide ,foods and supplements divided by symptoms. It’s a fantastic way to start.

I’ve been having Chilean Prunes for a while.

Ideally, look for:

1. Chilean Prunes these usually aren’t sweetened and are bigger. They are available across India.
2. Unsweetened always check the ingredients list on the packet to ensure there are no sweeteners added.

Take 5 every morning. It’s not like medicine, so it needs at least a year of consumption for you to see change. 

Most Indians have almonds in the morning. Have them with that. It's an easy way to remember to take them. 

They will also help with:

* Constipation
* Gut health
* Satiety and cravings

If you want something sweet post-meal, grab a few Chilean Prunes.

Other ways to retain and improve bone density:

* Strength training
* Jumping exercises
* Sufficient vitamin D levels

Food is a great proactive way to work on our health. If something as simple as eating prunes can help with bone density, why not do it?

Just like eating cooked tomatoes daily reduces the risk of prostate cancer in men. It can’t be the quantity in your curry though!!

Small things done repeatedly matter.
I prefer a proactive approach… what about you?

Also you can buy Chilean Prune easily ... they are available across India!

#ChileanPrunesIndia #Prunes #ChilePrunes #PrunesFromChile #Healthy".

48 likes, 2 comments - simrun.chopra on September 27, 2026: "The body is always giving us signs and if we know how to read them we can be more proactive than reactive with health. 

In kids I would look out for the most common 
Low iron - whitish tongue no matter how much they use the tongue scraper 

Low b vitamins - causes little blisters 

Dehydration for sure. A large number of younger kids are now getting kidney stones because they dont drink enough water. Check your kids water bottle when they are back from school. Ask them if they refilled and if so how many times 

Vitamin d : this usually shows up with repeated sprains, fractures, falling sick often 

Let me know if you found this useful 

Or if you want help around these topics too. 

Love Sim".

497 likes, 1,455 comments - simrun.chopra on September 23, 2026: "Comment "breakfast" and ill send you a bunch of high protein recipes both Breakfast and dinner. The 2 people struggle with the most

As a working mom juggling a 100 things to me food and health needs to be practical. It needs to be something you and I can do on repeat without driving ourselves crazy or disrupting our home.

Now Imagine if youre living in a multi generational home ... how would this work ? Could vou do it for life ?

To me these things make the word "diet" feel like a huge issue. Like it needs  sacrifice and its so hard

Just today I told someone how we need to increase her calories. And she was like" im already eating ao much more than before I started"
 Note : she lost 4kgs last month

I think people dont realise that you can eat as much as you want as long as your burn more.

I think we need to change the way the word "diet" is perceived and focus on getting healthier and fitter

What do you say ?".
